div.p: Out of scope: GoVecDB never generates embeddings. Running a model in-process means CGO and a model runtime — the end of "pure Go, zero dependencies, embeddable". Callers bring their own vectors.

g.text: service/ · httpapi/ · cmd/govecdbd — separate packages ABOVE the DB

div.h3: Everything in the DB box is RAM
div.p: Vectors are float32: 512 dims × 4 B = 2 KiB per vector, so 1M vectors ≈ 2 GiB before graph and metadata. Nothing here is paged from disk; a snapshot is a copy of it, never a cache it reads through.
service.Manager: one DB per collection directory. REST over it, stdlib only. Optional; the root package and internal/ never import these.

g.text: Open(dir, opts...) — restore, then open the log

ul.li: every value finite — one NaN compares false against everything and poisons the ordering; float metadata too
id non-empty UTF-8, ≤ 512 B; metadata a closed set of string / bool / int64 / float64, ≤ 256 keys
K ≤ 10,000; Ef == 0 means "choose it"; Filter validated once, never per node

g.text: The DB's locks (db.go, above type DB)

ul.li: writeMu — writers, across append and apply, so apply order = log order. Snapshot, Sync, Close take it; Compact only for its swap. No reader ever does.
snapMu — snapshot vs snapshot and Close; compactMu the same for Compact

div.p: Sync policy zero value SyncAlways (fsync per append). SyncInterval (50 ms) / SyncNever leave records in a 64 KiB user-space buffer. First failure is sticky → DB is permanently ErrReadOnly; reads keep working.

g.text: nodes — vector, per-level neighbor slots, tombstone

div.p: id → metadata, keys and strings interned. Filter evaluated inside the traversal, 0 allocs per candidate. Persisted only via WAL records and the snapshot's 2nd section.

text.tspan: then replay the log past its seq;
ErrCorrupt if the log no longer reaches back
